w: In the evening at 6.20 p.m. Swamishri arrived for the Sunday assembly at the Shree Swaminarayan Sanskardham. Swamishri was welcomed by 165 children enthusiastically waving flags. In his blessings Swamishri revealed, "One should have three addictions. One : Sing God’s glory. (bhajans)

Two : Do your work or duty. In other words endeavor in life. Three : Food. We need food but not by killing something. We should have a pure vegetarian diet. "One should have these three addictions and anything else is mere indulgence...
" The assembly was attended by 3000 devotees and well-wishers.
Swamishri celebrated the 172th birthday anniversary of Bhagatji Maharaj. ( See Special Report ).
Swamishri was extremely pleased on the sadhus who had completed a pilgrimage walk to Chhapiya, covering a distance of 1340 kms, in 41 days. ( See Special Report ).
Swamishri departed from Bharuch in the morning and arrived in Surat at 9.45 a.m. After having Thakorji's darshan, Swamishri left and arrived at the Swaminarayan Mandir, Bharuch, at 11.35 a.m.

Swamishri departed from Bharuch and arrived at the Swaminarayan Mandir in Anand at 7.55 p.m. After having Thakorji's darshan, Swamishri left for Vidyanagar and arrived at the Akshar Purushottam Chhatralay (APC) at 8.20 p.m.

At 5.15 p.m. Swamishri arrived in Umlav. He had performed the murti-pratishtha here 22 years ago. Today, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of the new murtis and then blessed the devotees. At 8.00 p.m. Swamishri arrived in Bochasan.
